hypotheses.S1_every_family_has_semantic_mode: For every family, the mode selected only by highest FineWeb own-family AUROC has TinyStories AUROC at least 0.70 for its frozen current-token predicate.
hypotheses.S2_semantic_modes_beat_random: The median TinyStories own-family AUROC of FineWeb-selected native modes exceeds separately FineWeb-selected matched-random directions by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.S3_family_labels_are_specific: For every family, its FineWeb-selected native mode's TinyStories own-family AUROC exceeds the same mode's FineWeb-selected best wrong-family AUROC by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.S4_weight_axes_predict_natural_coordinat: The median absolute site-level correlation between a mode's embedding projection and its natural Layer-3 coordinate is at least 0.30 on both corpora.
hypotheses.S5_labels_transfer_ood: The median retained fraction (TinyStories AUROC minus chance divided by FineWeb AUROC minus chance) of frozen own-family labels is at least 0.75.
hypotheses.S6_semantics_exceed_generic_token_form: For every family, its FineWeb-selected native mode's TinyStories own-family AUROC exceeds that mode's FineWeb-selected best generic token-form AUROC.
hypotheses.S7_family_tokens_are_weight_neighbours: For every family, at least one frozen mode places a family seed token among its 50 most extreme vocabulary embedding projections, and the median best seed-token rank beats matched random directions by at least a factor of two.
hypotheses.S8_native_axes_are_more_semantic_than_ro: The median TinyStories own-family AUROC of FineWeb-selected native modes exceeds separately FineWeb-selected axes from a frozen random rotation of the same family subspace by at least 0.05.
